I saved `/workspace/output/oracle.py`. I haven't run it, and it can't confirm the "saved after closing and reopening" part. I only looked at the one final-checkpoint screenshot, which I saved as the reference `final`.

In that screenshot the `atlas` note shows `Bring the blue notebook.` on the first line.

The oracle makes two image comparisons against `final`, both with the default tolerance:
- **Precondition:** the bottom toolbar strip (y 1175–1244). It is app chrome that doesn't depend on the note's text.
- **Behavioral check:** the first text line of the note (y 220–300). This fails if the text is missing, wrong, or not visible.

The oracle can't act, so it can't close and reopen the app. It only checks what is on screen at the checkpoint.

The text region is compared with no mask. A blinking caret in that strip could make a run fail, which would cost the credit. I didn't test for that.
